Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's effect to reduce the digivolution cost by 2 when I have a green and black 2-color Tamer?

Effect: When one of your Digimon would digivolve into this card, reduce the digivolution cost by 1 for each green or black Tamer you have in play.
